description.zh: 目标仓库是否设置为私有仓库
description.en: Specifies whether to set the target repository as a private repository.

description.zh: 源仓库分支，当需要将源仓库复制到目标仓库时传入该值。
description.en: The branch of the source repository. Specify this parameter when you copy a source repository to a target repository.

description.zh: 源仓库名称，当需要将源仓库复制到目标仓库时传入该值。
description.en: The name of the source repository. Specify this parameter when you copy a source repository to a target repository.

description.zh: 源仓库owner，账户名称或者组织名称。当需要将源仓库复制到目标仓库时传入该值。
description.en: The owner of the source repository. The owner can be an account name or an organization name. Specify this parameter when you copy a source repository to a target repository.
The name of the target repository.

description.zh: 目标（新）仓库owner，当传入SourceRepoOwner和SourceRepoName表示是从源仓库复制到目标仓库，否则仅新建目标仓库。
description.en: The owner of the target repository. If you specify SourceRepoOwner and SourceRepoName, the source repository is copied to the target repository. Otherwise, only a new target repository is created.

descriptions.zh: 请确保在使用该接口前有操作KMS secret对应权限。
descriptions.en: Ensure that you have the permissions to manage secrets in KMS before you call this API.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun oos create-git-repository --client-token TF-CreateApplication-1647587475-84104b89-eba5-47a8-b2fd-807b8b7d --platform gitee --owner JJGGu --source-repo-owner aliyun-computenest --source-repo-name test-repo --source-repo-branch main --target-repo-owner namexx --target-repo-name test-repo --is-private false --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --org-id 5ffd468b1e45db3c1cc26ad6 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun oos CreateGitRepository --region cn-hangzhou --OrgId 5ffd468b1e45db3c1cc26ad6 --Owner JJGGu --TargetRepoName 'test-repo' --TargetRepoOwner namexx --Platform gitee --SourceRepoName 'test-repo' --SourceRepoOwner 'aliyun-computenest' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ClientToken 'TF-CreateApplication-1647587475-84104b89-eba5-47a8-b2fd-807b8b7d' --SourceRepoBranch main --IsPrivate false
